Class ActionResolutionState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.states.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.model.states.ActionResolutionState
public class ActionResolutionState extends GameState
State representing the Action Resolution Phase. During this phase, players pick tribe and building cards according to the parameters granted by the OfferTile they placed their totem on.
